description: AI-powered customer support automation platform with multi-channel coverage, intelligent routing, and agent-assist. Specializes in mid-market SaaS and e-commerce.

evidence.description: Average 62% auto-resolution across SaaS clients, 45% for e-commerce (measured over 6 months)
CSAT maintained at 4.3/5 average post-deployment (vs 4.1 pre-deployment) across 20 clients
Native Zendesk, Intercom, and Freshdesk connectors. Salesforce Service Cloud via API.
Full context handoff with conversation summary, sentiment score, and suggested resolution
Supports 8 languages for auto-responses with native quality in DE, EN, FR, ES

red_flags: Weaker on phone/voice channel — primarily chat and email
Requires minimum 500 tickets/month for meaningful AI training
